jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type User

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "Address": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "street": {"type": "string"},
        "city":   {"type": "string"}
      },
      "required": ["street", "city"]
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "name":    {"type": "string"},
    "home":    {"$ref": "#/$defs/Address"}
  },
  "required": ["name", "home"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/refpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestUser_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"name":"alice","home":{"street":"1 Main","city":"Smallville"}}`)
	var u User
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &u); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if u.Name != "alice" {
		t.Errorf("Name = %q, want alice", u.Name)
	}
	if u.Home.Street != "1 Main" {
		t.Errorf("Home.Street = %q, want 1 Main", u.Home.Street)
	}
	if u.Home.City != "Smallville" {
		t.Errorf("Home.City = %q, want Smallville", u.Home.City)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(u)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"home":{"city":"Smallville","street":"1 Main"},"name":"alice"}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s", out)
	}
}

func TestAddress_DirectUse(t *testing.T) {
	var a Address
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"street":"x","city":"y"}`), &a); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if a.Street != "x" || a.City != "y" {
		t.Errorf("got %+v, want {x y}", a)
	}
}
